description: A React-like component definition for a shopping cart panel using LightningJS framework. This component manages cart entries, displays total price, and handles user interactions such as quantity adjustments, clearing the cart, and checkout confirmation.

classes.name: CartPanel
classes.description: A LightningJS component that provides a user interface for viewing and managing shopping cart items, including checkout confirmation overlay.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for a cart entry row based on its index.

methods.name: $inc
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a cart entry.

methods.name: $dec
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a cart entry, removing it if quantity reaches zero.

methods.name: $remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the cart.

methods.name: $clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: $checkout
methods.description: Handles the checkout process, clearing cart and showing confirmation overlay.
